GWA_Command.text: Ghostwind Arrow command deck — compact Fleet reconnaissance bridge with a central command position, navigation to port, sensor interpretation to starboard, probe/flight controls close enough for direct conversation, restrained shared displays, physical handholds, and repeatable access aft toward engineering. Deep navy, off-white structure, restrained gold Fleet identifiers. Violet appears only in technical survey/anomaly overlays.

GWA_SensorBay.text: Ghostwind Arrow sensor bay — a narrow working compartment directly adjacent to command, with calibration racks, removable sensor modules, local reference clocks, probe telemetry receivers, hard reference marks, and enough floor space for two people to compare hardware side by side. Functional, handled, not laboratory pristine.

GWA_Engineering.text: Ghostwind Arrow engineering — compact propulsion, power-conditioning and reciprocal-field support compartment with close clearances, labeled manual isolation points, access panels, service lights and visible paths to swap timing/sensor interface hardware without turning the room into generic machinery.

GWA_Airlock.text: Ghostwind Arrow scout airlock — small two-person EVA/probe service lock with white pressure surfaces, deep-navy equipment lockers, tether reels, probe cradles and a narrow exterior hatch sized for service rather than spectacle.

GWA_BeaconVolume.text: Unverified public-corridor beacon volume — a mature transit beacon and anchor infrastructure suspended against deep space. The public route remains red while verification is incomplete. Reference buoys, ranging points and low-tension survey geometry should be spatially legible.

GWA_CorridorInterior.text: Unverified reciprocal-field corridor — space appears mostly ordinary until reference stars, ranging geometry, duplicate tracks or shear markers stop agreeing. The anomaly should be visible through restrained physical disagreement, not magical fog or supernatural light.

GWA_VergerouteStaging.text: Verge convoy staging orbit — three work-worn civilian relief freighters and small support craft holding outside the red route. Tan/green hull markings, cargo modules, maintenance lights and ordinary logistics make the waiting cost visible.

GWA_ExitVolume.text: Far-side corridor exit volume — sparse anchor infrastructure and open space where a successful crossing can be verified against independent local references. Preserve orientation relative to the corridor mouth and returning convoy path.
